We've got 5,000 gallons of potable water scheduled for the coming week, and I'll be making the final distribution decision based on your formal update entries. The standard weekly requests are 1,300 gallons for the dining facility, 1,100 for sanitation services, 900 for the motor pool, and 400 for the clinic — that totals 3,700 gallons, leaving 1,300 as a base contingency reserve. Before I post the distribution plan, I need each activity representative to provide a formal update entry disclosing any changed requirements. If your needs haven't changed, please confirm that as well. Who's first?
